h1: US Visa Dropbox and Interview Waivers in 2026: Who Is Left, and Why It Is Not Always Faster
deck: The interview waiver used to be the cleanest way past a long queue. Two rounds of cuts in 2025 removed almost everybody from it, and at several posts the waiver queue is now longer than the interview queue it was supposed to replace.

coverSpec.title: US visa interview waiver eligibility after the February and September 2025 changes
coverSpec.desc: In February 2025 the interview waiver was narrowed to same-category renewals within 12 months of expiry, with first-time applicants removed. From 2 September 2025 it was cut again: H-1B, L-1, O-1 and most other common categories lost eligibility entirely. What remains is diplomatic and official categories, and B-1/B-2 or border crossing card renewals where the previous full validity visa expired within the past 12 months and the applicant was at least 18 when it was issued. Consular officers may still require an interview.
facts: H-1B, L-1, O-1 and most others
An officer can require an interview

faq.q: Who is still eligible for a US visa interview waiver in 2026?
faq.a: Two groups. Diplomatic and official categories, which covers A-1, A-2, C-3 other than attendants and servants, G-1 to G-4, NATO-1 to NATO-6 and TECRO E-1. And B-1/B-2 or border crossing card renewals, where the previous visa was full validity, expired within the past 12 months, and the applicant was at least 18 years old when it was issued. Everyone else attends an interview.

faq.q: Can H-1B and L-1 holders still use dropbox?
faq.a: No. From 2 September 2025 the most common employment categories, including H-1B, L-1 and O-1, lost interview waiver eligibility entirely. A renewal that would have been a document drop-off in 2024 is an in-person interview now, which is a significant change to plan around if you are timing a trip home around a visa stamp.

faq.q: What changed in February 2025 and what changed in September 2025?
faq.a: February 2025 narrowed the waiver to renewals in the same visa category within 12 months of expiry, and removed first-time applicants. September 2025 went much further: effective 2 September, the common nonimmigrant categories were taken out, leaving only diplomatic and official categories and a tightly defined B-1/B-2 renewal case. Two cuts in one year, and the second one is the one that caught most people.

faq.q: Is dropbox faster than an interview?
faq.a: Not always, and this is the part almost nothing tells you. Waiver processing has its own queue, and at some posts it is longer than the interview queue. In August 2026 several Mexican posts showed waiver waits for visitor visas running past 200 and even 300 days while their interview waits sat between 15 and 180 days. Check both numbers for your own post before assuming the waiver is the quicker route.

faq.q: If I qualify for a waiver, is it guaranteed?
faq.a: No. Meeting every condition makes you eligible to be considered, not entitled to it. Consular officers retain discretion to require an in-person interview at any point, and they use it. Plan on the basis that an interview may still be required, particularly if anything in your circumstances has changed since the previous visa was issued.

faq.q: Does the 12 month rule run from expiry or from issuance?
faq.a: From expiry. The condition is that the previous visa expired within the past 12 months, and separately that it was a full validity visa rather than a limited one. Applicants who let a visa lapse for longer than a year fall out of eligibility, which makes the renewal timing decision more consequential than it used to be.

faq.q: Does a waiver help with a long appointment queue?
faq.a: Sometimes, and less often than it used to. If you are one of the narrow group still eligible and your post's waiver queue is genuinely shorter, it is the cleanest route available and it costs nothing extra. If you are not eligible, or if the waiver queue at your post is longer, you are in the ordinary interview queue like everybody else, and the levers are the ordinary ones: widen your date range, check every post you may use, and work the calendar.
